pb-lead-generation.heading: Your prospects
pb-lead-generation.boundary: Find, review, then send yourself. No message leaves Chausar automatically.
pb-lead-generation.addressHint: Included on cold email drafts, with an unsubscribe line.
pb-lead-generation.osmNotice: OpenStreetMap may miss small shops. City lookup follows its usage policy; no directory scraping or list resale.
pb-lead-generation.empty: No prospects researched yet. Start with a city and your offer.
pb-lead-generation.ownerSource: Entered by you, from a walk-in or referral.
pb-lead-generation.sendYourself: Read it first. Use Pipeline to approve and open your own app; you send it.
pb-lead-generation.name: Contact name
pb-lead-generation.ready: Research and drafts are ready. Review every source before contacting anyone.
pb-lead-generation.manualReady: Contact added to your network and pipeline. Nothing was sent.
pb-lead-generation.happenstanceBoundary: Uses your own account and key. See the credit cost before approving each exact search.
pb-lead-generation.credits: {credits} credits for this search. Price checked {on}.
pb-lead-generation.keyHint: Used for this search only; never saved in a record.
pb-lead-generation.keyRequired: Enter your own key before approving.
pb-lead-generation.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This request did not finish. Check the details and try again.
pb-lead-generation.error.INVALID_VENTURE: Check the city, business kind, contact details and daily count.
pb-lead-generation.error.CITY_NOT_FOUND: City lookup is unavailable. Try later or add a referral.
pb-lead-generation.error.LEAD_SOURCE_UNA: The source did not answer. No missing facts were guessed.
pb-lead-generation.error.OUTREACH_BLOCKE: This person is on the never-contact list or was forgotten.
pb-lead-generation.error.PIPELINE_BLOCKE: This contact is blocked. No message was drafted.
pb-lead-generation.error.TIER_UNAVAILABL: Owner-entered contact import is available in the desktop app.
pb-lead-generation.error.APPROVAL_CHANGE: The search or its cost changed. Review a fresh quote.
pb-lead-generation.error.LEAD_RATE_STALE: The credit price needs rechecking before a search.
pb-lead-generation.error.HAPPENSTANCE_SE: The search may have used credits. Check Happenstance before trying again.
pb-lead-generation.error.JOURNAL_OUTCOME: An earlier search has an unknown outcome. Check it before retrying.
pb-lead-generation.error.JOURNAL_ALREADY: This exact search was already decided. Nothing ran twice.
pb-lead-generation.error.NET_LOOKUP: The source address could not be found. Try later.
pb-lead-generation.error.NET_TIMEOUT: The source did not answer in time. It was not retried.
pb-lead-generation.error.FETCH_POLICY_RE: This source does not allow automated reading. Paste permitted text instead.
pb-lead-generation.error.ROBOTS_REFUSED: This site asks robots not to read it. No page was read.
pb-lead-generation.error.RULE_UNCONFIRME: A lawyer must confirm the applicable outreach rules before client work.
pb-lead-generation.error.APP_APPROVAL_RE: Approve this action inside the Chausar app.
pb-lead-generation.product: Product in two or three sentences
pb-lead-generation.confirmCommunity: I confirm this product and that the community rules permit reading this post.
pb-lead-generation.noMatch: No post has two scores of four or more.
pb-lead-generation.communityBoundary: Paste only posts you may read. Quotes must match the post; nothing is posted or sent.
